presets.title: Closure, bars 85-92 (the standard kit)
presets.notes: The author's proof clip on the standard kit: a triple crash and a fill that should repeat the same sticking each time and does not (see limits). 8 of 106 judged notes are missed; 4 claps and 2 low floor tom hits are outside the kit map and left out.

presets.title: Dumbrock, bars 97-103
presets.notes: The author's own song, the densest drum span of the track. The weakest preset: 29 of 141 judged notes are missed, mostly collisions of the left hand at the snare, with one freeze.
